description: This file defines the APCu cache class for Opencart, providing methods for caching operations such as get, set, delete, and flush, specific to APCu.

classes.name: Apcu
classes.description: A class for managing APCu cache operations, with configurable expiration, active status checking, and methods to get, set, delete, and flush cache entries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache with an optional expiration time and determines if APCu is active.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by key if APCu is active.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache under the specified key for a certain expiration period.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cache entry by key if APCu is active.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Clears all cache entries if APCu cache clearing function exists.
